# Cajun Life Cafe

Cajun Life Cafe is a healthy-eating restaurant on Pratumnak Hill in Pattaya, Thailand, serving home-cooked Cajun and Creole dishes alongside Thai favorites. The menu is built around fresh, clean ingredients: high-protein dishes, no refined sugar, and gluten-free options throughout.

## What we're known for

- Cajun and Creole comfort food: gumbo, jambalaya, po'boys, blackened dishes
- High-protein options: protein pancakes, eggs benedict, grilled proteins
- Smoothie bowls, fresh juices, and coffee
- Build Your Own bowls with a full nutrition breakdown per ingredient (calories, protein, carbs, fat)
- Weekly meal prep with macro-tracked, customizable meals
- Gluten-free options across the menu
- No refined sugar in any dish
- A full healthy-eating guide with real menu nutrition data: https://cajunlifecafe.com/healthy-eating

## Practical info

- Address: 352/306-307 Pratumnak Soi 5, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
- Phone: +66 86 372 0084
- Hours: Every day, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- Price range: inexpensive to moderate
